core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mahfuj corresponds to the Arabic form محفوظ (Arabic root ح ف ظ (ḥ-f-ẓ); مَحْفُوظ (Maḥfūẓ)). Its core sense is protected, safeguarded, preserved. Mahfuj is a South Asian transliteration of Arabic مَحْفُوظ (Maḥfūẓ) 'protected, safeguarded', from the root ح ف ظ (ḥ-f-ẓ). The source gloss 'Contained, Protected' is broadly consistent. Same name as mahfoud, mahfouz and mahfuz.
